title: Two Work Packages write the same two story files and the same two fragments for legacy RWB-AD-016 on rwb-access
source: Work Package files _work/msr/wp/B-P4-04.md (fanout 5: legacy RWB-AD-012, AD-013, AD-014, AD-015 and AD-016, and its Write only block lists the two AD016 story files and the two AD016 fragments) and _work/msr/wp/B2-P4-010.md (fanout 0, the same four paths); _work/msr/plan/split_plan.json (exactly two slices for legacy RWB-AD-016: RWB-P4-AD016-CON in lane CG-W4, Day 1, and RWB-P4-AD016-APP in lane L-P4-J, ready after RWB-P4-E1038-APP, both wave 4, business epic EP08, release 30 June 2027, disposition Split (rework), patterns DP03, DP05, DP06, DP07, DP13 and DP19); _work/msr/status.json (156 keys and none is B-P4-04 or B2-P4-010); _work/msr/editlog (no B-P4-04.md, so the delivered files have no edit log of their own); _work/msr/gaps/B-P4-04.jsonl and _work/msr/assumptions/B-P4-04.jsonl (11 rows each for this key, the citation set the four delivered artefacts carry)
section: Whole story file set of RWB-AD-016 on rwb-access: the two story files and the fragments _work/msr/fragments/RWB-P4-AD016-APP.json and RWB-P4-AD016-CON.json
description: The plan carries two slices for legacy RWB-AD-016 on rwb-access (the contract baseline RWB-P4-AD016-CON and the application slice RWB-P4-AD016-APP), but two Work Packages of the run name them: B-P4-04, which lists RWB-AD-016 beside four other administration keys inside a fanout of 5, and B2-P4-010, which names the same two story files and the same two fragments alone with fanout 0. The four artefacts are present and complete in the tree: the APP story file is 64,777 bytes and the CON story file 41,064 bytes, written on 22 November 2026; each carries the two header lines of Template and Rules v1 R8.1, a D-RCV-60 change-log row with the tool line T3 Code / OpenCode / DeepSeek v4.1 Flash, the 20 metadata rows of R7.1 in order with the values this Work Package fixes (APP: work type APP, lane L-P4-J, ready after RWB-P4-E1038-APP, H to RWB-P4-AD016-CON, RWB-PLT-E1027-CON, RWB-PLT-E1042-CON, RWB-PLT-E1043-CON, RWB-PLT-N001-CON and RWB-P4-E1038-APP, C to RWB-P3-E1042-CON and RWB-P3-E1043-CON; CON: work type CON, lane CG-W4, ready Day 1, H, C, I and X all None), the 19 section headings of R7.2 in order, tables 12.1 to 12.9 in both, the R7.2 Level column in section 16, and no as-built heading because neither slice of RWB-AD-016 is preserved, delta, secondary or new. The APP file carries AC1 and AC2 of RWB-AD-016 word for word with the origin tags (legacy RWB-AD-016 AC1) and (legacy RWB-AD-016 AC2), the values limits by decision, level, product and amount, Risk approves the version, approvals check against it from its date and next level up with the incident kept unchanged, plus the one mock Given line the Work Package allows on the approval-router contract, and nine further criteria tagged (new, D-RCV-60); the CON file carries six criteria, all tagged (new, D-RCV-60), and they test only the contract artefact. Both keep the four legacy test case IDs TC-AD-016-01 to TC-AD-016-04 on the APP slice and mint no -ITG copy. Both fragments parse and carry the 28 keys Work Package item 8 lists with the Work Package values, and every CG and ASM id the artefacts cite resolves to a row of gaps/B-P4-04.jsonl or assumptions/B-P4-04.jsonl. The only difference from a fresh execution of B2-P4-010 is the citation family: the delivered set is CG-B-P4-04-AD016-101 to -111 and ASM-B-P4-04-AD016-101 to -111, and the contract slice states its legacy test case ownership in ASM-B2-P4-010-2 rather than restating the four rows.
evidence: wp/B-P4-04.md Write only block (the two AD016 story paths and the two AD016 fragment paths at the end of the block) against wp/B2-P4-010.md item Write only (the same four paths alone) name the identical artefacts; split_plan.json carries exactly two slices for RWB-AD-016 and both Work Packages name them; status.json has 156 keys and none is B-P4-04 or B2-P4-010; editlog holds B-P4-01, -03, -05, -06, -07, -08, -09, -10, -12, -13 and -14 and no B-P4-04; gaps/B-P4-04.jsonl holds the 11 CG rows CG-B-P4-04-AD016-101 to -111 and assumptions/B-P4-04.jsonl the 11 matching ASM rows; measured sizes 64,777 and 41,064 bytes for the two story files and 3,934 and 2,678 bytes for the two fragments; 19 section headings and 9 contract sub-tables counted in each file; the metadata rows, the gherkin of section 7, the test case tables of section 16 and the fragment key sets were extracted and compared row by row against the Work Package
proposed: De-duplicate the plan: one Work Package per story slice. Remove RWB-AD-016 from the B-P4-04 fanout list so B2-P4-010 alone owns this legacy key, or retire B2-P4-010 for this key. At step D1, number CG-B-P4-04-AD016-101 to -111 and ASM-B-P4-04-AD016-101 to -111 once and allocate no second set for B2-P4-010, beside the single CG-B2-P4-010-1 row this Work Package adds. Add a plan-uniqueness check to checks/run_all.py that fails when two Work Package Write only blocks name the same output path, and ask the B-P4-04 execution to write its edit log row so the delivered AD016 citation set has a traceable writer.
